subject: English
passage: In the Indus Valley region of Pakistan, archaeologist Yesenia Arce, geographic information specialist Ahmed Hassan, and colleagues have identified 33 smaller urban centers surrounding the ancient city of Dholavira. The researchers have concluded that these centers were administratively connected to Dholavira because each of the centers is from the same time period and features the same organizational pattern as Dholavira, with a citadel in the upper section and residential areas in the lower section. Their shared urban planning suggests that inhabitants of these centers likely followed some of the same administrative practices as those used in Dholavira.
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Researchers have determined that the organization of Dholavira's structures was based on those of other nearby urban centers.
choices.B: Administrative practices in Dholavira seem to have played a more significant role for its inhabitants than those in smaller, surrounding centers did.
choices.C: Although archaeologists have learned much about Dholavira through decades of study, they have only recently discovered the smaller centers that surrounded it.
choices.D: Researchers have inferred that Dholavira was connected to the smaller urban centers that surrounded it based in part on the similarity of their organization.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer because it most accurately states the main idea of the text. The text indicates that Arce, Hassan, and colleagues concluded that there is an administrative connection between the city of Dholavira and the 33 smaller urban centers they identified around the city. According to the text, the researchers reached this conclusion because Dholavira and the centers are from the same time period and organizational pattern in that all have a citadel in the upper section and residential areas in the lower section. Thus, the main idea of the text is that researchers have inferred that Dholavira was connected to the smaller urban centers that surrounded it based in part on the similarity of their organization.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. Although the text describes findings about Dholavira, it doesn't specify how much archaeologists have learned about Dholavira over the decades. Additionally, while the text indicates that the discovery of the 33 smaller urban centers surrounding Dholavira was made in the Indus Valley region and thus may be of recent date, this is a detail in the text, not its main idea.
